title: Collect tinder, kindling, and fuel
kid_text: Fluff, thumb sticks, then wrist sticks.

steps.text: Tinder is fluff no thicker than a match.
Kindling is no thicker than your thumb.
Fuel is as thick as your wrist.
Snap each stick. It must break.
Gather twice what you think you need.

mistakes.text: A stick bends and will not snap.
mistakes.fix: It is too wet. Set it aside.
